select.if: /*selectMasterMdCmPromotionMarketCategorySelPopList*/ SELECT A.STD_CATEG_ID , A.CATEG_NAME , A.CATEG_TYPE , A.CATEG_PATH , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRMTITEM WHERE CATEGORY_NO = A.STD_CATEG_ID) AS CNT FROM ICOMBYCA A WHERE A.COM_CODE = 'PRMTITEM' AND A.DEPTH = 1 ORDER BY A.CATEG_SYS_CODE

/*selectMasterMdCmPromotionMarketCategorySelPopList*/ SELECT A.STD_CATEG_ID, A.CATEG_NAME, A.CATEG_TYPE, A.CATEG_PATH, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRMTITEM WHERE CATEGORY_NO = A.STD_CATEG_ID) AS CNT FROM ICOMBYCA A WHERE A.COM_CODE = 'PRMTITEM' AND A.DEPTH = 2 AND A.PID = #{param3} ORDER BY A.CATEG_SYS_CODE

mapper.select: /*selectNewUserInfo*/ SELECT MAX((SELECT B.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR B WHERE B.USER_ID=A.USER_ID)||'('||A.USER_ID||')') AS USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR A WHERE A.COM_CODE = #{param1} AND A.REG_DATE < '20151231' AND A.USER_ID IN ( SELECT CODE FROM ( SELECT 'REGT', REGEXP_SUBSTR( (SELECT #{param2} FROM DUAL ),'[^' ||',' ||']+',1,LEVEL) AS CODE FROM DUAL CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR( (SELECT #{param2} FROM DUAL ),'[^' ||',' ||']+',1,LEVEL) IS NOT NULL ) X )

/*selectOrderUserInfo*/ SELECT MAX((SELECT B.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR B WHERE B.USER_ID=A.CODE)||'('||A.CODE||')') AS USER_ID FROM ICOMCOD2 A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE =#{param1} AND A.TYPE = 'REGT' AND A.CODE IN ( SELECT CODE FROM ( SELECT 'REGT', REGEXP_SUBSTR( (SELECT #{param2} FROM DUAL ),'[^' ||',' ||']+',1,LEVEL) AS CODE FROM DUAL CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR( (SELECT #{param2} FROM DUAL ),'[^' ||',' ||']+',1,LEVEL) IS NOT NULL ) X )
